turns.prompt_text: what are nuts bolts and washers made out of what material
turns.response_html:
Nuts, bolts, and washers are primarily made of carbon steel, stainless steel, or alloy steel.

Common Materials

  • Carbon Steel: The most common choice; often zinc-plated for basic corrosion resistance.
  • Stainless Steel: Used for high-moisture or chemical environments to prevent rust.
  • Alloy Steel: Treated for extreme strength, often used in automotive or industrial machinery.
  • Non-Ferrous Metals: Aluminum, brass, or bronze are used for weight reduction or electrical conductivity.
  • Plastics: Nylon or PVC are used when chemical resistance or non-conductivity is more important than strength.
